  "first_3_seconds": "A royal guard in red uniform and bearskin cap stands rigidly with a hand on his sabre, stating 'We will not.' The camera cuts to a close-up of a blond nobleman (Rupert) with bulging veins, screaming 'I said arrest him!' while the guard remains defiant.",
  "ending": "Alexander, revealed as the rightful Duke, stands with fierce cold retribution, telling Rupert 'we settle what you stole' as he rests his hand on his sabre hilt.",
  "problems": [
    "The reveal of Alexander's identity relies heavily on dialogue ('Alexander died!', 'This is my son... Alexander Ashburn') rather than immediate visual recognition, which might cause slight confusion for a stranger who doesn't know the backstory of the 'dead' heir.",
    "The emotional beat with the mother (18s-42s) is long and slow compared to the high-tension opening, potentially causing drop-off before the final payoff."
  ],
  "hook_score": 9,
  "cliffhanger_score": 9,
  "standalone_score": 7,
  "verdict": "post",
  "pitch": "The clip opens with an explosive confrontation that instantly establishes high stakes and betrayal, culminating in a dramatic identity reveal and a vengeful promise that demands resolution."
